flags.title: Coverage is partial
flags.detail: All 15 categories were researched, but neither paginated OLBG inventory nor every market was exhausted. A few selected discoveries are stored, not an exhaustive event list.

flags.title: No supported high-confidence recommendations
flags.detail: Observed bookmaker prices, calibrated forecast performance and complete match-specific inputs are missing. No high-confidence prediction is published and the 75-per-day target is unmet.

flags.title: Actual odds versus fair lines
flags.detail: OLBG vote shares are not win probabilities. No numeric bookmaker price appeared in the captured MLB event text. Fair lines must not substitute for the requested offered-price range.

flags.title: Old desks are not fresh evidence
flags.detail: 587 HTML pages existed at baseline. Many overlapping layers and hard-coded October 22 date filters remain archived. Their fixture, line and prediction counts are not added to this monitor.

flags.title: Coordination-board artifacts
flags.detail: Literal merge-separator/end-marker lines remain at baseline COORDINATION.md lines 3216, 3307, 3437, 3549, 3609 and 3628. Prior session history is preserved rather than silently deleted.

flags.title: UTC and today are not interchangeable
flags.detail: MLB Game 1 has officialDate October 23 but begins October 24 00:00 UTC. Unknown-zone URC/WST/F1/NRL times are left unconverted and cannot qualify for a timed pick.

flags.title: Gaelic Sports scope corrected
flags.detail: This monitor includes both OLBG Gaelic Football and Hurling within Gaelic Sports. Historical desks excluded hurling and added esports/Aussie Rules; those decisions do not match the present explicit 15-category request.

flags.title: Automation is not complete collection
flags.detail: Scheduled checks can capture public pages, detect evidence failures, extract OLBG links and parse MLB schedules. Other official adapters, exhaustive pagination, odds feeds, injuries and automatic original prose remain incomplete. Failed refreshes retain the capture age, never relabel old evidence as new.

flags.title: Pricing assumptions disclosed
flags.detail: Only the MLB two-way moneyline baseline is originated from sourced regular-season win/loss totals. It is uncalibrated, omits postseason form, pitchers and home advantage, and is low confidence. Handicap and total prices remain blank.

flags.title: Stored extracts are not raw captures
flags.detail: Agent fetch_page responses were transcribed into selected field extracts with source URLs and hashes. Hashes establish local integrity only, not source authenticity. Runtime HTTP captures use a separate ledger.
